# WiX / MSI Gotchas

> Known WiX Toolset and Windows Installer (MSI) patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Major upgrade wipes runtime-modified data files (config.json) despite NeverOverwrite](major-upgrade-config-wipe.md): RemoveExistingProducts scheduled early deletes the old product's runtime-modified config before the new install, orphaning the app; schedule afterInstallExecute + Permanent component. HIGH.
- [MSI ProductVersion limits differ from four-part executable versions](productversion-limits-and-upgrade-order.md): EXE versions allow fields that MSI rejects or ignores; use a bounded monotonic mapping and preserve application identity. HIGH.
